en: A black-and-white postcard showing a coastal town nestled in a bay with rugged hills in the background. There is a pier extending into the water, several small boats, and a large steamship emitting smoke. The shoreline is dotted with buildings, including a prominent round-roofed structure in the foreground, and the mountains frame the harbor. There appears to be handwritten text at the bottom, though it is reversed and partially obscured.
